items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: You're not related to George Foster or Willie Foster, those musicians by any chance. Not really. I'm not really.

ctx.x: But I was in Texas now, they wore a paper hat.

Yeah, I can move. No, well yeah, okay, if you want to move along, move over there for a minute. Yeah. Let's get your name down. Sit down next to me so you'll be close to the microphone and it'll pick your voice up. Now what is your name? Corrine Cook. Mm-hmm. And what was your name before you were married? Corrine Foster. You're not related to George Foster or Willie Foster, those musicians by any chance. Not really. I'm not really. I'm from Faro. I'm from Faro. Yeah, they're from up around McCall, that's right.…
